literal: To attain rare-thing when obtained, at that very moment, to do difficult deed [one must] do.
translation: When an opportunity that is rare to obtain comes your way, use that very moment to perform the deed that is otherwise difficult to achieve.
modern: கிடைப்பதற்கு அரிய காலம் வாய்க்கும்போது, அந்த கணத்திலேயே, செய்வதற்கு அரிய செயலைச் செய்து முடிக்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the critical importance of seizing the right moment. The phrase 'எய்தற்கு அரியது' refers to a rare and hard-to-get opportunity, while 'இயைந்தக்கால்' means when such an opportunity actually presents itself. The word 'அந்நிலையே' highlights the urgency, meaning 'at that very instant' without any delay. By acting immediately when the rare moment arrives, one can successfully accomplish a 'செய்தற்கு அரிய செயல்'—a great deed that is otherwise impossible to achieve.
